Per user instruction the program-level NERX_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED / KNN_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED flags stay UNRESOLVED: the authoritative per-family decomposition is to be rerun on canonical_v1 metaqa (43,234 exact-case entities), and no further legacy sweeps are to be launched.

_NOTE: Relabelled 2026-09-05 on user instruction: the Phase-4 H1_MINUS_NERX / H2_MINUS_KNN cells remove a family from candidate MEMBERSHIP while the family-dependent scoring stack (G1/G3 substrate) was not held fixed -- the same admission/scoring confound found in H3_STRUCT_ONLY. A significant metaqa regression on removal is therefore an established REMOVAL EFFECT on the legacy substrate, not proof of unique membership contribution. Resolve only after Part A M0/M1/M2 + clean per-family membership cells (membership varied, scoring fixed). Legacy substrate caveat: metaqa corpus here is the lossy lower()-collapsed 40,151-node KB, not canonical_v1. | UPDATE: the clean fixed-scoring membership test (CLEAN_MEMBERSHIP_TEST_M1_VS_M2) has now been run and de-confounds the M0->M2 loss; per-family flags remain UNRESOLVED pending a per-family fixed-scoring cell.
other_corpora: all five non-metaqa corpora: no significant effect either direction (three show 0/0 flips)

CLEAN_MEMBERSHIP_TEST_M1_VS_M2.what: M2_STRUCT_STRUCT vs M1_FULL_STRUCT_SCORE -- membership (STRUCT-only vs FULL) varied while the SCORING substrate is held STRUCT-only in BOTH arms. This removes the Phase-4 H1/H2 confound (which changed membership AND the family-dependent G1/G3 score mass together).
CLEAN_MEMBERSHIP_TEST_M1_VS_M2.interpretation: Only metaqa has a real COMBINED NERX+KNN unique-membership effect under fixed scoring (-0.0120, 25 queries lost, p=8.05e-07). On the other five corpora the membership component is <=0.0035 and never significant -- i.e. on 5/6 corpora essentially ALL of the STRUCT-only regression measured in M0->M2 is loss of aux-family SCORE MASS, not loss of unique candidate admission.
CLEAN_MEMBERSHIP_TEST_M1_VS_M2.still_unresolved: Per-family attribution (NERX alone vs KNN alone with scoring held fixed) was NOT run. NERX_UNIQUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED and KNN_UNIQUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED therefore stay UNRESOLVED; only the COMBINED flag above is established.

_label_history.AUX_FAMILY_SCORE_MASS_REQUIRED: SUPERSEDED_LABEL -- too narrow. M0->M1 swaps the family substrate used by SEVERAL scoring pieces (G1 neighbour substrate, G3 hyperedge substrate, struct-support), so it establishes the BROAD claim 'aux-family scoring signal is required', not specifically 'corroboration/support mass'. Corroboration mass remains the leading mechanism hypothesis, unproven.

causal_decomposition.M0->M1: value of auxiliary-family SCORING SIGNAL (membership held FULL)
causal_decomposition.M1->M2: value of auxiliary-family MEMBERSHIP (scoring held STRUCT-only)

architectural_summary.legend: YES = significant regression when removed; ~NO = measured but not significant; NO = exactly zero effect
architectural_summary.REFUTED_MENTAL_MODEL: 'FULL_C helps because NERX/KNN discover otherwise-unreachable useful nodes' is MOSTLY WRONG. For 2wiki_clean and hotpotqa_clean practically all of the benefit is auxiliary structure RE-RANKING nodes already reachable through STRUCT; their unique admission contribution is ~zero. MetaQA is the sole corpus that genuinely uses both channels.
architectural_summary.AUX_FAMILY_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED_is_TRUE_o: MetaQA. The other five effectively do not need joint auxiliary membership.

M3_interpretation_guard.claim: M3_FULL_SIMPLE_STRUCT regressions are NOT evidence that STRUCT itself is bad, and NOT evidence about the auxiliary family.
M3_interpretation_guard.decisive_case: webqsp: M1 ~= M0 (.9619 vs .9626, ns) but M3 << M0 (.8816, -0.0810, p=4.8e-35). WebQSP barely cares about the auxiliary-family substrate yet cares enormously about the richer NON-family-specific ranking computation that M3 removes. Different mechanisms.
M3_interpretation_guard.conclusion: Do not over-simplify the SP1 scoring stack. M3 refuted universally (sig on all 6).

H_METAQA_CANONICAL_HYPOTHESIS.statement: NERX probably owns most of the auxiliary-MEMBERSHIP benefit on metaqa; KNN may contribute primarily scoring/corroboration rather than unique admission.
H_METAQA_CANONICAL_HYPOTHESIS.evidence_basis: legacy 40,151-node metaqa substrate, per-family ladder under fixed STRUCT-only scoring: -NERX -0.0085 (p=2.21e-04, SIG), -KNN -0.0030 (p=0.0703, ns), -both -0.0120 (p=8.05e-07, SIG).
H_METAQA_CANONICAL_HYPOTHESIS.why_only_a_hypothesis: the canonical metaqa identity space changes from the lossy lower()-collapsed 40,151 nodes to 43,234 exact-case entities, so per-family attribution must be re-measured there.
H_METAQA_CANONICAL_HYPOTHESIS.test_on_canonical: rerun the four-arm ladder (FULL / -NERX / -KNN / STRUCT membership, all under fixed STRUCT-only scoring) on canonical_v1 metaqa, only if the joint membership effect survives.
